lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest, and Jesus sets a little child among them and says the humble one is greatest.
Jesus warns that causing little ones to stumble is terrible, and says to cut off a hand or foot that causes sin.
Jesus says a man with a hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine to search for one, because the Father wants none to perish.
If a brother sins and will not listen privately, take one or two priests along, then tell the church.

wrong_details.wrong: take one or two priests along
wrong_details.true: take one or two others along

lines.text: Jesus says if two agree about anything, the angels in heaven will do it, and where two or three gather, He is with them.

wrong_details.wrong: the angels in heaven will do it
wrong_details.true: it will be done for them by His Father in heaven
